summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_50 fixes, as player1 at 1920x1080. To get a WorldClientGame level I unregistered the service worker and used page.route to rewrite /api/world/level/N. No DB changes were made and no official attempt was used. ALL 5 ITEMS PASS. (1) The WorldClientGame (math_sprint) practice timer now counts down: world-client-practice-stopwatch went 00:54.043 -> 00:52.560 in 1.5s, with the caption 'PRACTICE MODE - NO ATTEMPT USED'. (2) The Skip practice button (world-client-game-skip) now uses 'fwv3-button fwv3-button-outline': white background, 2px purple border, purple bold text, same look as REPLAY DEMO. Clicking it goes to 'Ready to play?' (REPLAY DEMO / START ATTEMPT). (3) With colour_match the instructions title reads 'COLOUR MATCH'. (4) WorldClientGame instructions no longer repeat the guide text. The guide is now only in game-specific-instructions, and the bottom fwv3-info-box shows only 'Pass the skill challenge to progress...'. (5) Regression: opening free-world-level-32 (real data, number_sequence) shows no crash and no pageerrors in either run. The title is 'NUMBER SEQUENCE (1->20)' and the info box shows a single guide text. PLAY DEMO -> START DEMO -> the timer counts down (00:54.707 -> 00:53.640), and EXIT DEMO / SKIP DEMO are both there.

issues: The Gamepad2 icon is still small and sits off-centre to the left of the 'SKILL GAME / MATH SPRINT' title (carried over from iteration_50, low priority)
REPLAY DEMO / START ATTEMPT labels still wrap onto 2 lines (this was there before)

The gameName fallback now covers colour_match ('Colour Match') and number_sequence
FreeWorldNumberSequenceV3.jsx is still ~3000 lines; splitting it is recommended
The official WorldClientGame still has no exit/abandon control (iteration_50 note, not in scope)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Same recipe as iteration_50: add_init_script that stubs navigator.serviceWorker.register and unregisters existing registrations, then page.route /api/world/level/\d+ to override level.game_id. When colour_match is faked without game_config, the card shows '0 colours' and the colour demo word does not render. That comes from the fake, not from the app. Supply game_config.colour_count when testing colour via the route.
